population: all cases whose selected candidate changes between k=1 and k=3

outcome_classes.HELPFUL: k=1 verification failed and k=3 verification succeeded
outcome_classes.HARMFUL: k=1 verification succeeded and k=3 verification failed

evidence_driver_classes.PREFIX_SUCCESS_PRIORITY: selected k=3 candidate has a strictly larger prefix success count
evidence_driver_classes.ROBUST_DISTANCE_RANK_FLIP: prefix success counts tie and robust distance ordering changes

representative_rule: within each outcome class, largest absolute k=3 robust-score margin; break ties by seed
claim_boundary: Descriptive development audit only; no new decision rule or performance claim
